_comment: Title filter applied when expanding the crawl queue from the wiki's full page list. The Stellaris wiki hosts large third-party mod namespaces (Star Trek, Star Wars, Warhammer total conversions) and per-patch changelog pages. Neither teaches vanilla Stellaris, so they are excluded from the crawl. Edit this file and re-run `node scripts/expand_queue.js` to change what gets queued.
modPrefixes: Star Wars Legacy of the Old Republic
_notes: modPrefixes are matched case-insensitively against the start of a title, so 'ST NewHorizons/Races/Vulcan' is dropped.
Modding reference pages (Defines, Scopes, Effects, * modding) are KEPT - they document vanilla game data.
Subpages of vanilla topics (Species/Aquatic, Console commands/...) are KEPT.
